source.title: Call for Applicants - WRT Leader (November 2023)
source.content:
There will be an appointment of a new WCA Results Team Leader, as Sébastien Auroux is resigning from his position. We would like to thank Sébastien for the work he has done leading the Team.

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 6 hours per week to work for the committee. 

**The qualities expected of candidates are**:

* Strong leadership skills
* High level of trustworthiness and responsiveness
* Exceptionally detail-oriented, with a strong attention to precision for data handling
* Data management expertise, ideally experience with SQL (MySQL)
* Robust understanding of data governance and data protection principles
 <!-- break -->

The application period for candidates to submit their candidacy documents is from now until **27th November, 2023, 23:59 UTC**. Interested candidates can send the application privately to the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).

  
**The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:**

* Brief personal introduction.
* Summary of activities done for the WCA.
* Ambitions as the WRT Leader of the WCA.  


Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WRT can be found in [WCA Motion 10.2022.10.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.10%20-%20Results%20Team.pdf)

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of [WCA Motion 10.2022.0.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)

Thanks for your candidacies and support.

translation.title: WCA 成绩团队负责人招募（2023 年 11 月）
translation.content:
Sébastien Auroux 将辞去 WCA 成绩团队负责人一职，WCA 将任命新的负责人。感谢 Sébastien 在任期间带领团队所做的工作。

申请人应能够完成 24 个月的任期，每周至少投入 6 小时处理团队工作。

**申请人应具备以下条件：**

* 较强的领导能力
* 高度可靠，能够及时回应
* 做事十分细致，处理数据时注重准确性
* 熟悉数据管理，有 SQL（MySQL）经验更佳
* 深入理解数据治理和数据保护原则

申请时间为即日起至 **2023 年 11 月 27 日 23:59 UTC**。有意申请者请将材料私下发送至 WCA 董事会（board@worldcubeassociation.org）。

**申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含：**

* 简短的个人介绍
* 为 WCA 所做工作的概述
* 担任 WRT 负责人的工作设想

申请人还须提交一份可在申请截止后公开的申请材料副本。

WRT 的权利与职责见 [WCA 动议 10.2022.10](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.10%20-%20Results%20Team.pdf)。

申请截止后，WCA 董事会将依照 [WCA 动议 10.2022.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 4 节投票选出新负责人，经高级代表及现任委员会、团队负责人投票确认后公布。

感谢各位申请和支持。
